summary: Phase L review — 12-item batch for Alpha Omega Phi (Photos rebuild, Anniversary parent/sub-events, RSVP+guests, check-in ticket types, admin image uploaders, optional chat group picture, Meeting cards CRUD, mobile Gear). 27/27 backend pytest tests passed against the public preview URL (Photos: 48 albums returned with id/name/count/is_default/created_by/created_by_name; default albums cannot be deleted (400); member can create+delete own album; admin can delete a member-created album; non-creator member gets 403; /photos/bulk uploads 2 PNGs and count increments. Events: /api/events excludes every sub-event; Anniversary parent present; /events/{parent}/sub-events returns the 5 canonical sub-events (Transportation to Sip & Paint, Sip & Paint, Sneaker Ball Banquet, Transportation to Top Golf, Top Golf); RSVP on umbrella → 400 with 'umbrella' message; RSVP on Sip & Paint with 5 named guests succeeds and event.guest_count reflects +5; RSVP on Top Golf with 20 guests confirms unlimited capacity. Check-in: member general + every ticket_type for guest (vip, all_access, general, guest, speaker, volunteer) all 200. Uploaders: /chapters/upload-logo, /news/upload-image, /causes/upload-image, /meeting-cards/upload-image all return a /api/files/... URL. Chat: /chat/upload returns URL and POST /conversations persists avatar_url on the group. Meeting cards: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE all work; empty button_url returns 400; member gets 401/403). Frontend live verified on desktop 1280px: /photos shows '48 albums · 2 photos total' grid; clicking 10-Year Anniversary album opens detail with 'Upload photos' + empty-state CTA + back-link 'All albums'. /events shows the Anniversary parent (sub-events hidden from list). Clicking the parent → 5 sub-events with TICKETS badges all visible. /schedule-meeting renders 'Add card' + empty-state. /admin → Donations → Edit cause dialog shows cover-image Upload (cause-image-upload-btn visible). Chat → '+' dialog: picking 2+ members reveals 'Group picture (optional)' uploader (group-pic-upload-btn visible) and the CTA changes to 'Start group (2)'. Gear on 390px mobile: opening 'Trendsetters Hoodie' shows image up top + Color (Navy/Charcoal) + Size (S/M/L/XL/XXL) + Qty + PayPal + Pay Later visible on the same vertically scrollable panel with no clipping.

issues: Pre-login GET /auth/me, /chapters, /announcements probes throw 401 in console — expected (AuthContext bootstrap). Harmless.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~5856 lines — still well past the 700-line guideline. Recommendation persists: split into route modules (auth, members, events, photos, chat, gear, payments, admin). Same as iter-13/14.

POST /events/{id}/rsvp (line ~1291) deletes via _id rather than matching on (event_id, user_id) only after the lookup — fine, but if a member double-clicks the RSVP button two concurrent requests can race the umbrella check & insert. Consider a unique index on rsvps.(event_id, user_id) and an atomic upsert.

seed_anniversary_subevents() wipes ALL non-anniversary events on every server boot (line ~5519-5530). This is INTENTIONAL per the spec but is destructive — leave a giant code comment warning the next dev (currently only one short comment). Worth either gating behind an env flag or moving into a one-shot migration before any non-anniversary events are added back to the chapter.

/photos/bulk silently swallows per-file failures into a 'failed' list (good UX) but returns 200 even if zero files succeed. Frontend should surface partial-failure toast; currently UI only checks length of 'uploaded'.

ConversationCreateIn accepts avatar_url with no allow-list validation — any URL string is stored on the group. Consider asserting it begins with '/api/files/' to prevent injecting third-party tracking URLs as group avatars.

/api/chat/upload uses get_current_user (any logged-in member) and stores files under chat/{user_id}/... — same endpoint serves group-avatar AND attachment uploads. Fine for now, but no per-conversation membership check (member could upload then attach to a group they don't belong to — PUT /conversations enforces membership, so net OK).
/api/causes/upload-image, /chapters/upload-logo, /news/upload-image, /meeting-cards/upload-image all duplicate the same 2-line wrapper around _upload_image — could be a single factory. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up in-test: a handful of TEST_ prefixed photo albums (deleted), 2 bulk-uploaded PNGs left in a TEST_bulk_* album (harmless), a TEST_ meeting card (created+updated+deleted), a TEST_ group conversation (deleted), several guest check-ins on Sneaker Ball Banquet (all deleted), member RSVPs on Sip & Paint / Top Golf are toggled back off at end of test. No production data altered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase_l.py (27 tests, all passing). Anniversary parent + 5 sub-events are reseeded on every backend boot — server.py line ~5519-5530 wipes ALL non-anniversary events. /photos/bulk uses multipart field 'files' (List[UploadFile]) and 'album' form field. /events/{parent}/sub-events returns the 5 sub-events; main /events automatically filters parent_event_id IN [None, '']. /chat/upload returns {url: '/api/files/...', size: n}. POST /conversations accepts an avatar_url which is persisted as-is. /meeting-cards is gated by admin_tab_dep('members'). All 6 ticket_types accepted by /events/{id}/check-in. Mobile gear viewport 390x800 confirmed: image + variants + PayPal all fit in a single scrollable column.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions detected, all 12 items working end-to-end.
